authority_note: Derived projection. The canonical JSON is the single machine-readable source of truth; where this file and the canonical file disagree, the canonical file wins and this file is a bug.
resolutionOrder: 1. excludeNamespaces / excludeSuffixes (hard skip, no page, counted separately)
3. entryPointDirs override by simple type name
step3Matching: entryPointDirs is now a flat map of EXACT case-sensitive simple type name -> dir (7 entries). It must be applied AFTER longest-prefix resolution; skipping or mis-ordering it silently empties mission/ and core/.
matchSemantics: longest-prefix-wins. Do NOT use first-match. The array below is ALSO physically sorted so that first-match and longest-match give the same answer; if you add a rule, keep it sorted by descending prefix length. Rationale: TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.CustomBattle and TaleWorlds.*.ViewModelCollection must beat their shorter parent prefixes.
collisionRule: If two namespaces mapping to the SAME dir export the same simple type name, the page file is <NamespaceLeaf>__<TypeName>.md (e.g. Campaign__IFaction.md). Never write two files for one type.

entryPointDirsNotes._match: exact simple type name, case-sensitive, compared AFTER longest-prefix resolution
entryPointDirsNotes._why: Everything else was a no-op or contradicted 1.4.5 on-disk precedent. Measured 1.4.5 zh buckets: TextObject->localization (NOT core-extra), MBDebug->engine (NOT core-extra), GameModels->campaign (NOT core-extra), ViewModel/Game/GameStateManager/GameManagerBase/MBGameModel->core-extra, ScreenManager/ScreenBase/ScreenLayer->gui, GauntletLayer->engine, Save*->save-system. Those are all already produced by the prefix rules, so they need no override. Hyphenated/space-containing entries were unmatchable dead weight and are gone.
entryPointDirsNotes._parityGaps: MissionState lands in mission/ here but 1.4.5 has it duplicated in campaign-ext/+mission-ext/, not mission/ - 1 URL parity gap, accepted for modder-facing grouping. ModuleManager is NOT overridden: no 1.4.5 precedent exists, so it stays in modulemanager/ per its own prefix rule (one fewer override = one fewer silent failure).
entryPointDirsNotes._noModuleManager: There is NO ModuleManager type in any version: verified by full-tree scan of 1.4.5 (8583 .cs), 1.4.6 (11385), 1.4.7 (11387), 1.5.3 (11487) - zero occurrences of a class/struct/interface named ModuleManager, and 1.4.5 has no ModuleManager.md page. The modulemanager/ bucket holds the OTHER types of the TaleWorlds.ModuleManager namespace (DependedModule, Extensions, IPlatformModuleExtension, ModuleCategory, ModuleHelper, ModuleInfo, ModuleType, SubModuleInfo). Never synthesize a ModuleManager page.

deadRules.why: namespace TaleWorlds.Mission does not exist in bannerlord-1.4.7; Mission/Agent/Formation are TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade
namespace TaleWorlds.BoardGames does not exist; only TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.GauntletUI.Widgets.BoardGame exists, which maps to gui
namespace TaleWorlds.System does not exist in bannerlord-1.4.7

parityGaps.reason: The 1.4.5 gameplay/ bucket is semantically mixed: it holds SandBox(4), StoryMode.*(4) and bare TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade types (AgentNavigator, MapAudioManager, OppositionData, DelayedAction, NameplateSize, ...). No namespace rule can reproduce it. Bucket deliberately NOT created - SandBox* -> sandbox and StoryMode* -> storymode, which match the real namespaces.
parityGaps.decision: accept the 19-URL break; do not invent a bucket to make numbers line up

parityGaps.reason: 52 of 1.4.5's 78 mission/ pages are bare TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade types (Agent, Formation, ActionIndexCache, AutoGeneratedSaveManager, BannerTextureCreator, AgentHelper, GenericMissionObjective, ...). That is a hand-picked modder entry list no namespace rule can reproduce; faking parity would mean shredding the ~850-page mission-ext bucket and hand-maintaining a list.
parityGaps.decision: accept; mission/ stays a small intentional entry-class carve-out with bidirectional links to ../mission-ext/

parityGaps.reason: Game is namespace TaleWorlds.Core, which the prefix rules route to core-extra. 1.4.5 happens to keep a copy in core/ (and a duplicate in core-extra/).
parityGaps.decision: accept the 1-URL move; namespace consistency beats copying a legacy duplicate

parityGaps.reason: 1.4.5 has MissionState duplicated in campaign-ext/ and mission-ext/ and no mission/ copy. The entryPointDirs carve-out groups it with Mission/Agent/Formation for modders.
parityGaps.decision: accept the 1-URL break for modder-facing grouping

sourceTypoDecision: Typos in TaleWorlds' own source (Sandbox vs SandBox, Sandobx, Storymode). Ruled: EXCLUDE, do not map to sandbox/storymode - mapping would invent a namespace rule the source does not support. Listed here so the affected types are accounted for rather than silently dropped.
noModuleManager: There is NO ModuleManager type in any version: verified by full-tree scan of 1.4.5 (8583 .cs), 1.4.6 (11385), 1.4.7 (11387), 1.5.3 (11487) - zero occurrences of a class/struct/interface named ModuleManager, and 1.4.5 has no ModuleManager.md page. The modulemanager/ bucket holds the OTHER types of the TaleWorlds.ModuleManager namespace (DependedModule, Extensions, IPlatformModuleExtension, ModuleCategory, ModuleHelper, ModuleInfo, ModuleType, SubModuleInfo). Never synthesize a ModuleManager page.
noDuplicateRouteInvariant: One type = exactly one path. Same-dir name collisions use <NamespaceLeaf>__<TypeName>.md. mission/ (5) and core/ (2) are entry-point carve-outs beside mission-ext/ and core-extra/, not duplicates. See tools/_v147_nav-spec.md 6.2.
bucketsNotCreatedReason: gameplay and navigationsystem are ruled out by the Lead (parity gaps no-gameplay-bucket, and TaleWorlds.NavigationSystem -> core-extra). boardgames projects zero types (no TaleWorlds.BoardGames namespace). screensystem was reversed to gui. view/perks/final are 1.4.5-only shells with no canonical rule.
